name: Yong (Eighteen Kingdoms)
alt: Yong, one of the Three Qins

predecessors.name: Qin dynasty
predecessors.text: the Qin heartland west of Xianyang: 'central Shaanxi, and eastern Gansu' (Eighteen Kingdoms table)

successors.name: Kingdom of Han (Liu Bang)
successors.text: Zhang Han's kingdom, taken by Liu Bang: 'Defeated by Liu Bang' (Eighteen Kingdoms table)

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Zhang Han King of Yong.
206: Liu Bang attacks the Three Qins.
205: Feiqiu is flooded and Zhang Han dies.
205: the Kingdom of Yong ends with Zhang Han's death at Feiqiu (June or July 205 BC).

wars.name: Liu Bang's conquest of the Three Qins
wars.outcome: Liu Bang's forces captured Zhang Han's kingdom in a surprise attack in 206 BC; Feiqiu held out until the Han army flooded it in June or July 205 and Zhang Han killed himself.

certainty.note: The pages give provinces ('central Shaanxi, and eastern Gansu'), never a boundary; no treaty or survey line exists for a kingdom of one year.
